meta.title: TimeCapsule.fm
meta.description: Listen to the sound of places across the decades, with full provenance for every recording.

footer.honesty: Recordings labelled “reconstruction” are not authentic audio from the era they depict.
footer.label: Site

explore.title: Listen through time
explore.lead: Pick a decade, then a place. Every recording shows where it came from.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.heroTitle: Add a place's sound to the archive.
auth.heroLead: Sign in to upload field recordings, archive tapes and reconstructions — each published with its full story.
auth.lead: We'll email you a one-time link. No password needed.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.errorVerification: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
auth.errorDefault: Sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
auth.privacy: We use your email only to sign you in and, if you choose, to tell you about your submissions. It is never shown publicly.
auth.checkBody: If that address can receive mail, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires in 24 hours.

welcome.title: Welcome to TimeCapsule.fm
welcome.lead: Two quick things before you contribute.
welcome.displayNameHelp: Shown as the contributor on recordings you publish. It doesn't have to be your real name.
welcome.incomplete: Please choose a name and confirm your age.

account.title: Account
account.displayNameHelp: Shown as the contributor on your published recordings.
account.emailNotificationsHelp: When a recording is published, needs changes, or is taken down. You'll always see these here too.
account.noNotifications: Nothing yet. Updates about your submissions appear here.

contribute.title: Your contributions
contribute.lead: Upload a recording, tell its story, and send it to our moderators.
contribute.step1: Upload WAV, FLAC, MP3 or OGG audio — up to 200 MB and 30 minutes.
contribute.step2: Describe the place, the time, where the audio came from, and its rights.
contribute.step3: Accept the contributor agreement and submit. A moderator reviews every recording.

editor.saveError: Couldn't save — retrying when you edit
editor.recordingLead: A title and a description of what listeners will hear. The description doubles as a text alternative for people who can't listen.
editor.placeLead: Where it was recorded. Names in English and, if different, in the local language.
editor.timeLead: The year the sound represents, and when this audio was actually captured.
editor.rightsLead: Where the audio came from and who holds the rights. Be precise — this is shown with the recording.
editor.pendingBody: A moderator will listen and check the details. Withdraw it if you need to make changes.
editor.withdrawn: Withdrawn. You can edit it again.

h.titleLocal: Optional. For example 渋谷スクランブル交差点.
h.sceneDescriptionEn: At least 20 characters. Describe the scene, not the people in it.
h.countryCode: Two letters, e.g. JP, FR, EG.
h.eraYear: For an authentic recording this is the capture year.
h.syntheticDisclosure: Required for reconstructions: what you combined or generated, and from which sources.
h.speechConsent: Recordings where a private person can be identified speaking need their consent.

missing.titleLocalLang: Language code for the local title
missing.publicPlaceAttested: Confirm it's a public place (for ~100 m precision)
missing.capturedRange: The capture end date is before the start date.
missing.eraMatchesCapture: The year must fall within the capture dates. If this audio was made later to evoke the past, choose “Community reconstruction” as the source.

audio.lead: Upload the original file. We remove all embedded metadata (GPS, device, software) and make a streaming copy.
audio.replace: Drop a new file to replace the audio
audio.limits: WAV, FLAC, MP3 or OGG · up to 200 MB · up to 30 minutes
audio.uploadFailed: The upload didn't complete. Please try again.
audio.tooLarge: That file is larger than 200 MB.
audio.tooLong: That recording is longer than 30 minutes.
audio.unsupported: That isn't a WAV, FLAC, MP3 or OGG audio file.
audio.processingDetail: This usually takes under a minute. You can keep filling in the details.
audio.privacy: Your original file is deleted after processing; only a checksum is kept.

rejection.unsupported_format: That file isn't WAV, FLAC, MP3 or OGG audio. Please upload a different file.
rejection.format_mismatch: The file's contents don't match its type. Please upload the original file.
rejection.unreadable_audio: We couldn't read that file as audio.
rejection.too_long: The recording is longer than 30 minutes.
rejection.too_short: The recording is shorter than one second.
rejection.too_large: The file is larger than 200 MB.
rejection.missing_object: The upload didn't arrive. Please upload again.
rejection.processing_timeout: Processing took too long. Please try a shorter or simpler file.
rejection.processing_error: Something went wrong while processing. Please upload again.

location.mapLabel: Map: click to place the recording

site_100m.label: About 100 m
site_100m.help: Public places only — a station, square or park.

location.publicPlace: This is a public place, not a home or private property.
location.publicPlaceHelp: ~100 m precision is only allowed for places anyone can visit.
location.preview: Published as an area centred near {lat}, {lon}. The exact point you choose is never stored.
location.noPoint: Click the map or type coordinates. Only the coarse area is stored and shown.

editor.stillNeeded: Still needed before you can submit:
editor.noAgreement: Submissions are closed while the contributor agreement is being prepared.

confirm.rights: I have the right to share this recording under the license I chose.
confirm.accuracy: The provenance I gave is accurate to the best of my knowledge, and reconstructions are labelled as such.
confirm.consent: No identifiable private person is heard speaking without their consent.

editor.submitted: Submitted. A moderator will review it.
editor.submitFailed: Couldn't submit. Check the highlighted steps.
editor.agreementOutdated: The agreement was updated. Please reload and review it.
editor.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
editor.confirmDelete: Delete this submission? This can't be undone.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.lead: Listen, check the details against the checklist, then publish or explain what needs to change.

audioQuality.label: Audio quality
audioQuality.help: Clear enough to be worth hearing; no heavy clipping or long silence.

rights.label: Rights confirmed
rights.help: The license and rights holder are plausible for the stated source.

location.label: Location accurate
location.help: The place, city and map area match the description and audio.

noPrivateSpeech.label: No private speech without consent
noPrivateSpeech.help: No identifiable private individual is heard speaking unless they consented.

moderation.reasonHelp: Required to reject (at least 10 characters). The contributor sees this.
moderation.approveNeedsAll: Tick every checklist item to approve.
moderation.ownSubmission: You can't review your own submission.
moderation.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.

legal.takedownIntro: If a recording on TimeCapsule.fm infringes your copyright, includes you speaking without your consent, or otherwise should not be published, tell us and we will review it promptly. Recordings under review can be unpublished while we investigate.
legal.placeholderNotice: Placeholder details. The designated agent and contact address must be confirmed before launch.
legal.include3: Why it should be removed (for copyright: the work you own and how it is infringed).
legal.include4: A statement that you are acting in good faith and that the information is accurate.
legal.formLead: We read every request. Your contact details are only used to handle it.

basis.privacy: Privacy — I can be heard or identified

legal.fieldStatementHelp: At least 20 characters. For copyright, describe the work you own.
legal.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that this use is not authorised, and the information I've given is accurate.
legal.sendFailed: Couldn't send. Please try again or email us.
legal.limited: Too many requests from your connection. Please try again later or email us.
legal.formPrivacy: We don't publish your name or email. They're kept with the request and visible to moderators only.
legal.sentBody: Thank you. A moderator will review it and may unpublish the recording while they do.

demo.banner: Demo deployment — browsing synthetic placeholder recordings only. Sign-in and contributions need the full backend.
demo.signInTitle: Sign-in is off in this demo
demo.signInBody: This deployment runs without the API, database and storage, so accounts, uploads and moderation are disabled. Browse the map and list, and play the demo recordings.
